files..config/pulse/daemon.conf:
# Created by the awm mic service. A user config file replaces
# the system one outright, so pull the system defaults back in
# first and override below.
.include /etc/pulse/daemon.conf

### awm virtmic: keep PulseAudio resident
# Without this PulseAudio exits ~20s after the last client
# disconnects, destroying the runtime-loaded virtmic sink.
exit-idle-time = -1
files..config/pulse/default.pa:
# Created by the awm mic service. A user config file replaces
# the system one outright, so pull the system defaults back in
# first and override below.
.include /etc/pulse/default.pa

### awm virtmic: declare the virtual microphone sink
# Rebuilds the virtual microphone on every daemon start, so a
# restart can't leave recorders reading a dead default source.
load-module module-null-sink sink_name=virtmic sink_properties=device.description=VirtualMic
set-default-source virtmic.monitor
